title: Holographic $s$- and $p$-wave superconductors from the $4D$ regularization of Einstein-Lovelock theory
summary: We investigate holographically dual descriptions of $(2+1)$-dimensional s-wave and p-wave superconductors in the framework of regularized four-dimensional Einstein-Lovelock gravity theories, incorporating higher curvature corrections beyond the Gauss-Bonnet sector. We first implement the 4D regularization of Einstein-Lovelock gravity with finely tuned coupling constants to include corrections up to any $K$th order in curvature.
